cards.hearing: You may be hearing that borrowing costs are back in the news, with long-term interest rates climbing to one of their highest levels in a long while, and mortgage rates following them up.
cards.why: That matters because it touches real household decisions, like financing a car, carrying a credit card balance, or buying a home.
cards.but: But a move in interest rates this week does not rewrite a plan built for years, not days.
cards.story: Picture someone who refuses to sign a lease the week rent goes up a little, so they just keep paying more somewhere else instead. Waiting for the perfect rate often costs more than just moving forward with the plan you already have.
say: We built your plan to handle moves like this.
Rates shift. We do not redo the plan every time they do.
